These are synthetic fixtures, not a real project or participant.
Each `state.json` validates against `schema/discussion-state.schema.json`.
Each `posts.jsonl` uses the Lane I normalized post shape.
Instance-derived fixtures (for example `delving-2749/`) are test data only.
They are never engine input.
`bips-2212/state-seed.json` is a hand-seeded catalog (the extractor never mints options).
`bips-2212/extract-run.json` is a recorded Maple gemma4-31b run log of the hand-seeded catalog.
